facts.fact: Adwave campaigns charge the advertiser's daily budget, starting from $30 per day, drawn from a prepaid wallet.
facts.quote: Campaigns charge your daily budget (from $30/day) from a prepaid wallet.

facts.fact: Adwave states it has no subscriptions and no contracts, and advertisers can pause anytime.
facts.quote: No subscriptions, no contracts, pause anytime.

facts.fact: Adwave's launch page says its campaigns can run across Meta, Google, Reddit, TikTok, web, mobile, and television from a single daily budget.
facts.quote: launches one campaign across Meta (Facebook, Instagram, and more), Google (YouTube and Search), Reddit, TikTok, web, mobile, and television from a single daily budget.

facts.fact: Adwave's website says analysis of a site is free, and users can see their plan before spending.
facts.quote: Free to analyze. See your plan before you spend.

facts.fact: Adwave's launch page states that Adwave proposes ideal customer personas from the advertiser's website.
facts.quote: It proposes ideal customer personas from your website, packages image and video creatives
